files.modifications: Explicitly enable AV_CODEC_FLAG_FRAME_DURATION and set each generated video frame duration to one codec time-base tick. Propagate trailer and output-close errors. main is renamed only at compile time.

use: Directly compile the upstream API example for P00 software-codec validation. Its stream setup, encoder send/receive and muxing API flow is also adapted by src/services/media/Mp4Encoder.cpp (exact additional source mapping in mp4-encoder-upstream.json), with production frame/audio sources, checked owned-descriptor output, real monotonic timestamps, cancellation and first-error-preserving teardown. The example's generated media is never a production capture source.

reference.use: Decoder and drain API flow adapted in tests/qt/software_codec_probe.cpp; full original license retained.
